protocol.eligibility: strict snapshot can_select frozen across horizon; owned unselectable may remain
protocol.evaluation: 2025-26 is already consumed historical evidence, not an untouched holdout
protocol.h0: distinct all-prior-season direct model; not identical to M4E matched-OOS-population control or v2; both remain frozen
protocol.historical_fit: 2021-22 through 2024-25; fixed design before 2025-26 evaluation; no selection

preprocessing.categorical_null: literal __missing__; does not imply any actual status
preprocessing.encoding: training one-hot, all categories retained; unknown all-zero
preprocessing.null_semantics: Computational fills only; original missingness indicators retain meaning. No null-as-fit interpretation.
preprocessing.numeric_imputation: training median; all-null column fallback 0 with indicator retained
preprocessing.scaling: training StandardScaler on imputed numeric columns; both families use same projection

protocol.prices: static current purchase prices; exact initial selling prices until sold; repurchased players sell at purchase price
protocol.production_fit: all five prior seasons; settlements strictly before 2026-07-01
protocol.season_end: truncate at GW38; no labels beyond season end
protocol.state: one accepted M3 state at g; no future features, fixtures, minutes or recursive predictions
protocol.target: individual GW g+h points from verified M3 labels joined by season/element; absent future population or unlabelled GW stays missing
protocol.uncertainty: descriptive residual quantiles only; no risk penalty

contract.dependence: within-player donor trajectory; common historical as-of block induces cross-player covariance of block means across target offsets; conditional on block, donor trajectories are independent
contract.eligibility: complete offsets 0..H-1 at one original as-of/player; season-end and missing labels excluded explicitly
contract.exchangeability: current players exchangeable with complete historical donors; overlaps and one consumed season are not independent validation
contract.interpretation: projected simulation diagnostics, not realised benefit, conditional calibration or model selection
contract.joint_law: uniform anchor among sorted complete trajectories selects as-of block (probability block size / total); each current player independently draws one donor uniformly WITH replacement within that block and keeps all H residuals
contract.null_law: each player/horizon independently samples the corresponding component of a uniform complete donor; same marginal population as joint, deliberately removes both dependencies
contract.points: original binary64 forecast plus raw signed residual; no centering, clipping, rounding, retraining or recursive state
contract.rng: NumPy Generator(PCG64(seed)); sorted (as_of_gameweek, element) donors and ascending current IDs; scenario-major calls: joint integers(N) anchor then integers(block_size,size=P); null integers(N,size=(H,P)); int64 draws; separate RNG restarted with same seed for each model; count extensions preserve prefixes
contract.source: exact reconstructed M5C calibration; 2025-26 residual y-p only; no prospective outcomes
contract.statistics: population SD ddof=0; linear percentiles; inclusive M5C interval coverage; negative points retained; covariance uses population denominator
contract.storage: no raw cube; exact little-endian float64 C-order (scenario,horizon,ascending element) SHA256 of residual and points plus donor-index trace SHA256; reconstruct from bound sources/seed/software
contract.unsupported: specific current player identity, position, club, opponent, match, pairwise competition and conditional rotation risk; no cross-publication scenario coupling
